game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge, a rope bridge over a crevasse: the ice axe ranger must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the rope bridge.
theme: Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge: a rope bridge over a crevasse
core_gameplay_loop: In Crevasse Bridge, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the rope bridge. Each round, falling rocks strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge: keep the vault_keys meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: vault_keys drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crevasse Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while vault_keys > 0.
